text:
priya: Quick sync — we need to lock down what counts as a launch for the Optimize toolkit (batching, caching, quant recommendations, eval-triggered alerts). Customers are asking for clarity on pilot acceptance and what we support day 1.
sam: MVP vs GA? I propose MVP = in-console actionable recs + eval alerts to webhook. GA adds per-route autosuggests + exportable rulebooks.
anna: +1. Also need to decide data retention for eval alerts (how long we keep prompt/eval traces). Some customers require 90d audit logs.
kai: Engineering constraints: batching/caching heuristics need runtime metrics (seq length distribution, prefix reuse) before we recommend quant profiles. For MVP we can support heuristics based on sampled traces.
jordan: From SRE: define latency SLO degradation tolerated when batching is enabled. We need a fallback policy to non-batched model variant on overload.
priya: Customer asks: Acme wants per-route quant recs and a way to opt a route out of quantization. Is that in scope for pilot?
sam: For pilot we can allow route-level flags but not automated per-route rollout. Manual opt-in is fine.
anna: Launch gating: must-have items = 1) eval-alert webhook with dup suppression, 2) basic recs UI, 3) pilot docs + migration guide, 4) telemetry metrics (cache hit rate, batch size distribution).
kai: Engineering checklist: sample job for traces, two quant profiles (fp16 & int8 sim), prefix cache proto, and an ops command to clear cache.
jordan: Ops checklist: circuit breaker thresholds, fallback logic, and dashboard for batch latency percentiles.
priya: Acceptance criteria draft:
```
- Eval alerts firing on regressions defined by preset thresholds
- Recommendations surface per-model and per-deployment (hosted/dedicated)
- Telemetry shows cache_hit_rate >= 15% or clear guidance if lower
- Rollout plan that supports manual opt-out per-route
```
sam: Risk notes: quant recs incorrectly suggested -> customer quality regressions. Mitigation: require A/B guardrail with eval set before applying automated quant.
anna: Docs: include an "If you see quality drop" quick rollback snippet:
```
# revert quant on route
redwood routes update --route my-route --quant none
```
kai: Perf test plan: run 3 workload profiles (short-chat, long-context, streaming) across fp16/int8 and record p95, p99.
priya: Pilot timeline: 2-week alpha with 3 customers, then 2-week wider beta. Want sign-off criteria by end of alpha.
jordan: Who owns the pilot customers? @sam can coordinate, ops will standby.
sam: I can onboard Acme + BetaCo for alpha. Need runbook + support rota.
priya: Action items: 1) kai to prototype trace sampler (due 3 days), 2) anna to draft pilot docs (5 days), 3) sam to confirm pilot customers (2 days), 4) jordan to draft SLO/fallback thresholds (4 days).
priya: Thoughts on eval-trigger policy: alerts fire only after N=5 failing evals in 24h to reduce noise.
anna: +1 on debounce. Also add a user-visible reason in the alert payload.
priya: OK lets reconvene in 48h with updates. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy status: branch optimize-toolkit/alpha -> staged (tests passing) :rocket:
